notes.title: Vulture Strike Launch
notes.content:
Vulture Strike is now available on Steam, for Windows, macOS and Linux, for a discounted (-20%) price. A free, limited demo version is also available for download.

You can also purchase the soundtrack as DLC, at a special launch price.

notes.title: Demo V.1.0 released
notes.content: The free demo for Vulture Strike has just been updated to version 1.0. Improvements include: better performance, balance tweaks and minor bug fixes. Soon, release date for the full game will be announced.
